scope.description: Active PHP Supplier recommendation author, explicit independent platform classification/review, actual UniApp category big-card consumption.

contract.proposal: Supplier 商品推荐图选择、清除、普通保存/回读，连接公共图片签名与 UniApp 分类大图消费
contract.why: PHP Supplier真实启用的5:2推荐封面。当前普通TS编辑没有作者/GET/POST字段，尽管来源复制已隐藏继承、公共products响应已投影并按持久owner校验签名。新UniApp分类解析丢弃该字段且大图组件始终主图，形成可独立完成的作者到消费者闭环。

php_references.contract: 未注释的商品推荐图FormItem，点击modalPicTap(dan,recommend_image)，可显示已选图，建议5:2。属于Supplier实际商品编辑器。
推荐图默认空；getPic对应case把真实素材att_dir赋给formValidate.recommend_image；整体productAddApi提交表单。
POST product/product/:id；不是Admin独有保存路径。
Supplier保存明确接收recommend_image；强制待审核、快递，由当前supplierId交给saveData。
仅unset描述/券/attrs等关系输入，recommend_image留在主表data中；在整体事务内update或insert。主图仍由slider_image[0]单独派生，推荐图不是替换主图。
实际分类模板按level/index分派；template2用于2/2、2/3、3/1、3/2，template3用于2/1、2/4。
仅2/3或3/1大图模式优先recommend_image，否则image；有推荐图时高度216宽540即5:2且不叠主图活动边框。
2/1大图模式同样优先推荐图，5:2；其余行/网格布局不是这个图片选择合同。
公开products接收is_big，只选择big/mid缩略图类型，image/recommend_image是两个独立返回字段；不能在服务器全局覆写image替代推荐图。

history.covered: 既有Supplier媒体迁移覆盖主轮播、SKU、正文和视频；公共商品图签名已有成熟服务。完整复制已验证隐藏recommend_image继承与撤销后拒绝。

copy_proof.contract: 真实来源private媒体复制后推荐图保持canonical；签名不落库；来源隐藏recommend_image不可用会拒绝整份复制。

history.open_gap: 没有发现Supplier普通推荐图作者或分类大图优先推荐图的已完成记录；当前源码明确无这两端实现。不要把已有隐藏继承误报成普通可编辑。
rejected_alternatives: 商品口令command_word虽PHP控件启用，但存储字段的真实消费用途尚未核实，不优先做仅能读写的孤立字段。
视频开关video_open在PHP真实可关闭且保留link，但近期视频上传审计明确已采用按非空link派生开关的TS合同；这是需要单独协调的既有行为决定，本建议不顺带更改。
赠券/推荐商品/modal及is_sub残余变量不足以证明当前Supplier实际作者启用，不追未接线残留。

bounded_contract: 普通POST可选recommend_image；undefined/缺省保持现有隐式保留，完全不提SQL目标列；显式空字符串清除，合法引用替换。不能新增null/bool等模糊清除。
GET给canonical稳定值，预览通过现有media.previews签名；签名/expiry不得保存。坏历史必须可安全读取、不渲染，可省略保留或显式清空修复；SQL权限错误不可伪装成不存在。
仍使用成熟ProductImagePicker与当前Supplier/attachment权限，锁真实素材metadata直到完整产品保存提交；新图/未变私有旧图都不能以存储旧字节取得外店素材权限。
清除只影响recommend_image，slider/main/SKU/description/video/价格/库存/隐藏关系/表单答案全部保持；普通保存仍下架/待审核。需要主表字段真实回读以拒绝skip/rewrite，组合保存末端复核避免后来作者改变最终值或资格。
完整复制继续来源隐藏继承和成熟UUID/HMAC回执，不扩大SUPPLIER_COPY_FIELDS；复制页可明确只读说明，创建后在普通编辑调整。
UniApp只在layout=big（2/1、2/3、3/1）用合法推荐图并5:2展示，空/拒绝/加载失败回退主图；row/grid继续主图。不要仅因is_big=1就全局替换image，筛选网格也会发送该参数。
公共读取必须先经独立Admin审核公开，未审核/下架商品不可因已保存推荐图而公开；保持当前owner字段与签名权威、分页/价格/促销/购买语义。

verification_entrypoints.purpose: 可继承现有ownedPG16、实际App/JWT、独立最小LOGIN、本店31/外店32及fake本机只读R2，新增推荐图专属fixture而非改成熟helper。
原媒体归属、canonical保存、签名预览、真实锁竞争回归。
隐藏推荐图复制、撤销和UUID/HMAC不得回归。
成熟StoreProductService公开products/推荐链与促销元数据；追加真实Supplier保存后独立审核再读推荐图并校验签名。
真实category组件/composable/解析器与全部十种level/index矩阵；追加有/无/坏/加载失败推荐图、big与row/grid回退且购买事件未改变。
参照生产bundle+实际App/JWT/PG16控制页审计：选图尚未保存零POST；保存canonical回读、清空及route/session ABA；另开实际H5分类big布局截图证明消费者。

must_cover_positive_negative: 本店私图选→取消无POST/DB不变；选→真实完整POST→canonical回读+有效短期预览；显式清除后主图不变、公开big回退。
合法HTTPS/根相对图片与256边界；javascript/http/凭据/坏privateID/外店32/附件type或module错配拒绝且零业务写。
只读、匿名、跨店、过期/撤权、原始pwd版本变化；遗漏字段不会把0/坏历史改掉，真实UPDATE OF触发器证明未提列；遗漏并发Admin更新保留新值。
before UPDATE skip/rewrite和后续作者/约束触发器修改实际推荐图或素材归属，正控制证明执行，再断言失败及完整业务回滚；不声称PG序列回退。
真独立审核后/api/products读同商品，推荐图签名有效且不落库，外店/撤销素材无签名；主图、售价、SKU/stockledger/旧订单与答案不变。
十种分类样式矩阵中仅三种big布局优先5:2推荐图；空、坏、过期/加载失败回退；完整identity/购买事件和未知cart恢复不变。
contract.execution: 仅只读源代码/历史检查；未运行heavy、浏览器、DB、联网或改仓库文件。

proposed_product_scope.reason: PHP recommendation-image control has no product-type guard. This is product metadata only; preserve existing immutable fulfillment type and all card/virtual inventory rules. Do not open new types2/4.

real_public_classification_bridge.reason: Supplier ordinary save requires own type2 category11 and rewrites type1 category relations. Actual public tree exposes platform type0 and H5 calls category-scoped products. Existing Admin classification is required before independent approval; actual extra classification writes will be recorded separately.
real_public_classification_bridge.second_save: Explicitly reselect own category11 through Supplier UI before clear/save; perform actual platform classification100 and independent review again.

pre_implementation_ts_evidence.contract: 普通输入类型、productValues和productDetail DTO均无recommendImage/recommend_image；现状省略时隐式保留存储值。
现有mediaTarget只支持slider/sku/sku-batch/description；无推荐图控件或字段。
现有recommend_image varchar256非空默认空，无需新DDL。
普通公共产品列表已有recommend_image投影。
真实公共列表走DAO及decoratePublicProductCards，保留成熟价格/促销消费。
主图和推荐图作为独立refs，按持久type/relation_id校验后签名，不需要新公开图片权威。
既有公共图片路径校验活跃Supplier、R2图片metadata、实际owner、canonical路径与对象folder/MIME，再生成短期签名。

实际产品卡片仅用product.image，即使layout=big；需保留独立推荐字段并仅在big优先它。
实际分类页传入big/row/grid布局，现有购买/购物车事件不应改变。

http_contract.input: optional recommend_image only; absent/undefined means no SQL column; exact empty string clears; any other non-string rejected. Normalize existing media raw<=4096 then canonical<=256; private tickets/absolute private aliases become stable /api/assets/id.

transaction_proof: Explicit recommendation intent uses existing Supplier actor/authentication row locks, product-write barrier, timeouts and owner checks.
Private image uses existing media SHARE metadata row lock, current public owner/folder/MIME eligibility, and full admitted metadata snapshot.
Main UPDATE RETURNING cardinality and immediate full actual-row SELECT reject skip/rewrite; SQL omission branch remains unchanged.

After existing authors and SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE, compare complete expected main row including every requested approved association, current eligible metadata snapshot and final live Supplier authority.409 rolls back all business rows; no sequence-rollback claim.

public_contract.scope: Main and recommendation arrays are separately bounded by existing100-card page, indexed reassembly retains order. Only recommendation explicitly passes256. Other callers retain255 and unchanged actual-owner private-media authority.

native_scenarios: Real App/JWT and independent minimum Supplier LOGIN; SELECT-only preview/actual asset; types0/1/3 save-clear preserving complete SKU/price/cost/stockledgers and historical order/answer baseline.
Private signed/absolute alias canonicalization and new product creation; malformed/null/foreign/missing and contradictory actual metadata rejected before rows/sequences.
Historical bad refs read+omit+clear; same canonical private ref still revalidates owner; real SQL metadata denial not unavailable.
Anonymous/viewer/foreign/denied/expired/changed-password refusals; UPDATE OF positive tripwire proves omitted/undefined no column.
Independent commissioned Admin-column LOGIN holds actual product row; observed pg_blocking_pids proves omitted Supplier HTTP save preserves newer committed image.

Real private metadata writer lock; skip/rewrite positive controls; later description trigger and initially deferred trigger alter recommendation or same-ID metadata with rollback; later actual role revocation rollback.
Actual Supplier save then independent Admin JWT POST moderation and public /api/products+real signed asset, metadata revocation unavailable, explicit clear/review/public fallback.
Two exact256 root-relative/HTTPS public positive controls and default255 other-public-call negative control;257 author rejection.

real native denial followed by table UPDATE grants; explicitly not SELECT-only SKU/relation

Browser already compares all full SKU rows against baseline after all six explicit writes.

Reopen recommendation picker, select 本机推荐图片31, click 使用所选图片. Control #before_save must return saves0 before clicking 保存并提交审核 in editor. First real Supplier POST stores canonical /api/assets/31 and retains all SKUs, stock ledgers, hidden metadata and historical order/answer rows.

Inspect saves1 classifications1 approvals0 JSON. Then #approve performs another pending-empty public GET and actual Admin set_verify POST. Inspect counts1/1/1.

Control #status inspect checkpoints cancel,before_save,before_clear;2 saves;2 classifications;2 reviews;4 pending-empty read proofs;2 catalogEvidence stages;2 cancellation proofs;old-form invalidation;outbound0. Click #finish; require actual Vitest exit0 and final result JSON. Every control uses actual click with successful JSON receipt, never unacknowledged Enter.
